name: Blink: A Step Between
description: A thin folio with a doorway drawn on the cover and no door in it. The first exercise is to step across a puddle without crossing it.
notes: The tome that teaches the Blink spell (mw-e06.12). Item id equals the spell id so the cover art id is ui-book-cover-blink. Licensed arcane magic, uncommon. Study time is 60 minutes. Base value 220 sits above the first-step tomes: it is a tier 2 spell and tooUseful (constitution section 4).
